- Approval status:

## Evidence boundary
Unit tests validate software behavior only. Simulation validates only the modeled scenarios and assumptions. Component, assembled-system and field tests are distinct evidence levels. No IP rating, fire resistance, battery safety, functional safety, cybersecurity certification or regulatory compliance may be claimed without appropriate independent test/assessment evidence.
